plain: Holding supreme power, answering to no outside authority

webster.text: Supreme in power; possessing supreme dominion; as a sovereign prince.

more.text: Supreme; pertaining to the first magistrate of a nation; as sovereign authority.

example.quote: In addition to all this, there is, in the nature of sovereign power, an impatience of control, that disposes those who are invested with the exercise of it, to look with an evil eye upon all external attempts to restrain or direct its operations.
